records.body:

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

records.text: New signup alert -- *Ridge Labs* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 0 (2026-08-25), but no key milestone and no invite in 6 days, and two Wrenfield emails (email:078b3245, email:a363d026) went unanswered — no customer reply at all, suggesting low engagement. Pro plan and an active sub give some upside; 8 days remain.

draft.subject: Next step after your first Ridge Labs project
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Following up on my note last week — you've got your first project set up, which is the main thing. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so the next step is usually getting real work into that project and a teammate alongside you. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whichever part is least obvious.

Best,
Priya
